notes.title: Patch Note (21st June 2017)
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have update few things that users felt uncomfortable.
Please check the patch note below:

1. Added UI to check User Information
2. Support Full Screen Mode (Left ALT + Enter)
3. Fixed potion recovery rate in dungeon
4. Fixed bugs that showed Korean text after enchanting stones.
5. Fixed bug that users could not receive 800 Cash although they purchased the DLC. We have sent them the reward.

Any other suggestions are welcomed and we will try our best to improve our game!

Thanks all and enjoy :)

notes.title: Game Control
notes.content:
Many of you might have hard time finding control keys of the game.
Sorry we did not mentioned inside the game.

Please see below for control key command:

Movement: W A S D / Left Click
Attack: J / Right Click
Potion: 1 & 2
Skills: 3~8
Loot & Interact: Space Bar

notes.title: Thanks All for your Comments!!
notes.content:
We really appreciate your comments, both positive and negative.

However, since we are a developer located in Asia, we might response to your comments little late.
Hope you guys can understand that and we will do our best to reply ASAP.

Also we are new to STEAM so please let us know how  we can improve :)

notes.title: Delphinia Chronicle on STEAM!
notes.content:
Hi all supporters!

Stay tuned and enjoy our game when it gets LIVE!

Any questions are welcomed :)
